title: Runtime Evidence Gate v1
description: Machine-readable runtime-evidence gate for a single experiment run. Records which runtime commands were executed, where their outputs are archived, and a per-check rollup (validation_status). The mandatory does_not_establish list keeps the artifact bounded: a runtime-evidence gate documents execution, not model quality. Form is validated here; semantic rules (path existence/escape, pass-consistency, mandatory disclaimers) are enforced by scripts/docmeta/validate_runtime_evidence_gate.py.

validation_status.$comment: Rollup over checks[]. Semantic rule: 'pass' is only legal when every check is 'pass' with existing evidence; otherwise use partial / fail / missing_evidence.

does_not_establish.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. Must include the baseline disclaimers enforced by the validator: model_quality, comparative_superiority, adoption_readiness, production_correctness, absence_of_regressions, security_readiness, promotion_readiness, outcome_assessment, external_model_independence.

known_limitations.$comment: May be empty only when validation_status == pass. Non-pass statuses require at least one explicit limitation.

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes are rejected here; parent-escape ('..' that resolves outside the repo) is rejected semantically by the validator with a stable rule id.

exit_code.$comment: null means the command was not executed (no runtime evidence captured).
